cause_quote: The Anthropic backend added `askuserquestion: "ask_user",` to its native capability map, causing capture to reject the newly projected name as non-canonical.
user_saw: Every Claude CLI turn failed before a reply whenever Claude Code advertised its default native question tool.
summary: The fix adds `ask_user` to the canonical native capability vocabulary so Claude CLI turns can complete with native questions enabled.
reasoning: The fix PR reports that published OpenClaw 2026.10.4 completed all nine turns with the same Claude Code version and `AskUserQuestion` enabled. I checked the causing commit's parent, where the existing projection skipped `AskUserQuestion`, and verified that the core validator stayed unchanged from that parent through the fix's parent. The new mapping sent `ask_user` to that validator, which threw before Claude could reply.
